about: Void is a link-only shelf for things that were vetted and found genuinely valuable, but do not belong in the collection: they are platforms, plugins, dashboards, or infrastructure — not standalone skills — or they duplicate an entry that already exists. Void entries are NOT skills and are never counted anywhere: not in the skills total, not in any category, not in the MCP count, not in tag statistics. Nothing here is vendored; each entry only links to its source. Capped at 12, vetted only — Void never flows into skills.json or mcps.json.

entries.description: A Claude Code plugin that learns reusable skills from successful sessions and manages their lifecycle: merging similar skills, updating stale ones, archiving unused ones, and protecting manually written ones.
entries.name: autoharness
entries.title: AutoHarness
entries.why_not_included: It is a plugin, not a skill: its single SKILL.md routes every change through its own stage_skill tool, which only exists inside the plugin, so there is no importable standalone skill.
entries.why_valuable: The most credible self-learning skill layer in the wild — it turns real session experience into maintained, deduplicated skills instead of letting them rot.

entries.description: Long-term memory system for agents: CLI plus MCP server plus Postgres, with markdown and git as the source of truth and hybrid vector-plus-graph search.
entries.name: gbrain
entries.title: GBrain
entries.why_not_included: Infrastructure, not a skill: its ~80 shipped SKILL.md files are GBrain-operator procedures that only work against a running GBrain instance.
entries.why_valuable: An excellent memory layer, and the memory job is a genuine gap the collection has no entry for — persistent agents need somewhere to remember.

entries.description: Collaborative AI design workspace — desktop app plus CLI plus MCP server — with a library of 565 skills covering design systems, templates, and craft rules.
entries.name: open-design
entries.title: Open Design
entries.why_not_included: A platform, not a skill: its skills are OD-coupled (od: frontmatter, its own design systems and craft rules), and its best skill names — algorithmic-art, color-expert, copywriting, brainstorming — already exist in the collection.
entries.why_valuable: A huge, real design-skill library — the largest single source of design craft in the agent-skill world.
